## Personality

Susan is a grim-faced yet kind-hearted elderly spinster. Despite being an old maid, she maintains a fondness for men rather than speaking ill of them.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)_

## History

Despite her willingness to marry, Susan never had a suitor or beau. She served as household help for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), remaining in the role on Gilbert's insistence to ensure [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could rest. She joined the family and friends in celebrating the birth of Anne's healthy son, James Matthew, and later heard the news of a [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) election victory shared by Captain Jim. After temporarily leaving to care for her injured sister, Susan returned from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with news and commentary, and she subsequently discussed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's planned move to the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P0](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P2](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0002), +40 more_

## Quotes

> “Do not tell me,” said Susan fiercely, answering the anguish in Marilla’s eyes, “that God could be so cruel as to take that darling lamb from us when we all love her so much.”
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005)

> “Now for breakfast,” she said briskly. “I am of the opinion that we will all be glad of a bite and sup. You tell young Mrs. Doctor not to worry about a single thing—Susan is at the helm. You tell her just to think of her baby.”
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)

> "Oh, the poor lamb—the poor lamb! How can she bear it, Miss Cuthbert? I am afraid it will kill her. She has been that built up and happy, longing for that baby, and planning for it. Cannot anything be done nohow, Miss Cuthbert?"
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P18](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0018)

> “And it is such a sweet baby,” sobbed Susan. “I never saw one so white—they are mostly red or yallow. And it opened its big eyes as if it was months old. The little, little thing! Oh, the poor, young Mrs. Doctor!”
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P20](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0020)

> "Have a good time and do not worry about the pantry. Susan is at the helm. There is no use in keeping a dog and doing your own barking. I am going to take your breakfast up to you every morning."
>
> — Susan — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P3](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0003)

## Relationships

### [Matilda](../character/matilda.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/matilda--susan.md)

[Matilda](../character/matilda.md) is Susan's sister. When [Matilda](../character/matilda.md) suffers an injury, Susan temporarily leaves her work at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's house to travel to the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) and care for her.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019)_

### [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/owen-ford--susan.md)

Susan is a friend of [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), a visiting writer who boards at Leslie's house. She admires him and takes great pleasure in the compliments he gives her regarding her cooking.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007)_

- Friend of — admires him and his compliments on her cooking (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007)</sub>
